title: Arena skill producer states are described as actual successful execution, and settlement lacks its surviving-battler gate
ordinary_control: A living user executes an ordinary nonimmune, unprotected single-target move successfully: the completed processing state receives normal effectiveness and assigns skill +1. The state-to-skill table itself is correct when its actual state inputs are supplied.

minimal_counterexample.preconditions: Arena single battle; attack-phase skill slots are 0; opponent uses Protect before a living user attempts Tackle; normal execution and PP gates pass; Protect is effective, the move can be protected, Unseen Fist is absent; no secondary callbacks, recoil, replacement, or terminal outcome.
minimal_counterexample.trace: The target protection check marks protection and rejects that target. The hit processor returns false because no target is affected. The surrounding target-processing branch still records the completed-processing state (2), sums only unaffected=false targets and therefore obtains total effectiveness 0, then settles the living user. State 2 ignores the protection flag and assigns skill -2.
minimal_counterexample.reference_expected: Attacker current skill slot -2, accumulated at round end.
minimal_counterexample.formal_reader_expected: Reading “真正完成且成功” plus “被保护失败→不写” as a live behavioral rule gives unchanged slot 0. This conflates the labeled state with actual hit success.

additional_precondition_gap: Settlement traverses existing, nonfainted battlers. A battler already at 0 HP is excluded even if its state is pending; the source does not settle every member of the entire battler array. Early execution/PP failure returns before the assumed-failure state is written. A later surviving battler action may settle an earlier pending whole-move failure; the last-action qualification in P26 is significant.
negative_search_scope: Full focal Arena 1–366 and selected UseMove 1–662 / success-check consumer ranges; no Arena-only guard around the ordinary settlement.
cancellation_and_partial_failure: Preserve the existing last-action whole-move failure/no-EOR-backfill rule; distinguish pre-state failures, pending state settled by a later action, and actual target blockage. No rollback guarantee is introduced.
minimal_fix: Describe state 1 as written only after execution/PP gates and usage bookkeeping reach its producer. Describe state 2 as completion of the target-processing branch, including zero affected targets, rather than requiring actual success. Qualify settlement to currently nonfainted battlers. Keep the direct state-to-skill table, explicitly restricting protected preservation to state 1; add a live Protect counterexample.
proposed_clean_room_wording: 处理进入目标阶段并走到该阶段末尾时会写入完成状态，即使全部目标被保护或未命中；有目标时，相性只合计未被判无效的目标，全部排除则合计为0。完成状态按相性赋值技槽，合计0赋−2；保护标记只在仍处于失败状态时使技槽保持。结算只处理当前存在且尚未倒下的战斗者。前置资格或PP失败尚未到写入失败状态的时点。
dependencies_and_sync_files: WP40/WP43 execution and protection cross-reference; revise only if duplicated language is found
tests: Living Tackle against successful Protect: slot 0→-2; damage remains 0.
Direct state1/protected=true fixture preserves prior skill, without presenting it as ordinary Protect behavior.
Settlement excludes an already fainted battler; last-action early whole-move failure retains prior skill, whereas a later eligible settlement may consume its pending state.
verification: Static semantic derivation; no reference execution or runtime test.

title: Active Safari and Bug-Catching Contest sessions can be saved through ordinary Quit Game
severity_reason: The contract excludes an ordinary visible user flow that persists active activity state. An independent implementation following the exclusion would differ in save reachability and omit recovery compatibility for an active contest with separated party members. No claim of observed data loss or host crash.

formal_locations.clause: Mode saving generalized from dedicated Save command visibility.
Normal persistence restricted to unstarted/ended sessions.
SF01 says no saving during mode.
SF30 tests hidden Save but does not distinguish ordinary Quit Game save.

sources.behavioral_evidence: Available menu command list comes from registered visibility conditions; selected effect runs.
A command without a condition is available.
Dedicated Save has mode visibility gates.
Quit Game has no mode visibility condition. Accepted quit opens shared save screen, then closes menu/ends scene without inspecting save return.
Save screen confirms save and optional overwrite, then calls normal save without a mode guard.
Normal save has no activity gate and reaches serializer after its normal state prefix.
Compiled saved values are each read and top-level validated.
Player object saved whole, including current contest singleton party.
Compiled save values are serialized to the requested file.
Global metadata owns Safari and contest session state.
Safari start marks session active and supplies budget/origin/steps.
Contest start separates other party members into global session state and leaves chosen member in player party.

preconditions: Ordinary map/pause UI reachable, player and normal registered save values valid; no plugin/replacement handlers.
Safari session active and current map satisfies its region query. For the contest counterpart, valid chosen member and configuration, active session with ample unexpired time.
No unrelated callback/state change during the confirmation sequence; user accepts Quit Game and Save, and any required overwrite confirmation.
Normal serializer/File IO succeeds. No runtime execution or actual save file was used in this review.

ordinary_contrast.without_mode: Dedicated Save is available when system saving is enabled, and normal save can serialize state.
ordinary_contrast.active_mode: Dedicated Save is hidden, but Quit Game remains visible and opens the same save screen. Activity state is not ended or cleared by this effect before saving.

actions: Choose Quit Game (the ordinary game exit, distinct from mode-specific Quit).
Accept save and any overwrite confirmation; successful normal save.
minimal_counterexample.expected_from_reference: Save serializer receives global metadata containing the still-active Safari session, then Quit Game closes the menu and sets scene to nil. No Safari end or return-to-start consumer ran in this path.
minimal_counterexample.conflicting_formal_expectation: WP53 line 244 permits normal save persistence only for inactive/unstarted/ended sessions.

contest_counterpart.initial_state: Valid active contest, selected party member at index zero, spare party held in session, 20 balls and optional retained K, unexpired duration.
contest_counterpart.expected: Quit Game save can persist active contest session, spare party, retained K and monotonic origin together with the current one-member player party; this is serialization reachability, not a promise about resumed timer semantics.

cancel_exception_partial_commit.quit_rejected: Menu refreshes/reopens; no save invocation, assuming no unrelated time callback.
cancel_exception_partial_commit.save_rejected_after_quit_accepted: Shared save returns false; Quit Game still closes menu and ends scene. No new normal save write is made.
cancel_exception_partial_commit.overwrite_rejected: Shared save returns false before normal save; Quit Game still proceeds to exit.
cancel_exception_partial_commit.handled_io_failure: Save returns false after normal prefix; only save count is decremented. safesave, magic number and saved-time prefix are not rolled back; possible file truncation/partial write remains unverified. Quit Game still exits if shared flow returns normally.
cancel_exception_partial_commit.unhandled_validation_or_other_error: Already completed prefix can remain; ordinary tail/exit is not guaranteed when an exception prevents shared screen return.
cancel_exception_partial_commit.mode_specific_quit: Safari-specific Quit marks result and returns to start; contest-specific Quit judges. These are distinct commands and do not rebut ordinary Quit Game save.

title: 默认设施表的两处旧身份在当前目录与 Gen5 目录下产生不同编译结果，尚无具名向量
preconditions: Frozen default tower PBS and current root item/move identifiers; normal successful item/move compilation and list compilation, or compatible loaded registries with exactly these identities.
No plugin or supplemental root file defines STICK or VICEGRIP; no author modification of the table; all preceding parse dependencies succeed.
Gen5 comparison is explicit optional alternate registered catalogs, not automatic backup selection; no files are copied or compiled in this review.
Rewriting/instantiating results additionally requires successful respective consumer stages.
normal_control: The documented parser tolerates missing item identity as nil and skips missing move identities. With catalogs actually defining STICK/VICEGRIP (the Gen5 backup profile), these two fields survive the parser. Current-root LEEK/VISEGRIP are different identifiers; handlers mentioning both do not register data aliases.

minimal_counterexample.input: Default template index137 / PBS line140: FARFETCHD with STICK, RELAXED, three EV labels and SLASH/KNOCKOFF/SWORDSDANCE/AGILITY.
minimal_counterexample.current_root_expected: Species/nature/moves remain, item becomes nil; successful subsequent materialization has no held item; successful PBS rewrite emits an empty held-item field.
minimal_counterexample.gen5_registered_profile_expected: STICK resolves and the held-item identity is retained.

minimal_counterexample.input: Default template index249 / PBS line252: CRAWDAUNT with PERSIMBERRY, ADAMANT, HP/DEF/SD and BUBBLEBEAM/VICEGRIP/KNOCKOFF/PROTECT.
minimal_counterexample.current_root_expected: VICEGRIP is dropped and survivors compact to BUBBLEBEAM/KNOCKOFF/PROTECT. It is not automatically renamed VISEGRIP and no fallback move is inserted because three valid moves remain. Successful rewrite preserves three survivors and an empty fourth slot.
minimal_counterexample.gen5_registered_profile_expected: All four listed move identities survive.

negative_search.summary: Root PBS section membership and all scripts searched. No STICK or VICEGRIP data alias definition found. VICEGRIP has no script hit. STICK hits are handler compatibility or a move blacklist, not registry entries. Precompile rewriting only covers VictoryME/BaseDamage. Compiler discovery is root PBS/*.txt, not recursive backups. Entire formal set searched for both legacy spellings; no named template/vector exists.

impact: Generic parsing rule is already correct. Gap is concrete compatibility evidence for shipped default inputs: current-root compilation loses an item and a move which an explicitly selected Gen5 registry can retain. A clean-room test corpus may otherwise exercise only synthetic unknown identities and omit shipped cases. No claim that the entire generator/host fails.
minimal_fix: Append two implementation-independent named static vectors near WP76 §8.4 or its GN tests. State active-root registry precondition, nil item / compacted three moves, successful later rewrite conditions, and optional Gen5 alternate-ID contrast. Keep paths/lines in audit only. Do not edit reference data or add aliases to future behavior.
proposed_sanitized_text: 当前默认设施候选中的 FARFETCHD／STICK 与 CRAWDAUNT／VICEGRIP 是具名数据兼容对照。仅在采用当前根目录物品和招式目录、无额外身份定义且解析正常时：前者持物转空；后者跳过 VICEGRIP，剩余招式按原相对顺序成为 BUBBLEBEAM、KNOCKOFF、PROTECT，不自动改名为 VISEGRIP。后续创建或反写成功时分别消费该空持物与三招式结果。显式采用含 STICK／VICEGRIP 的 Gen5 身份目录时，两处身份可保留；备份不会因存在而自动进入当前目录。以上为静态推导，未执行编译、创建、对战、反写或完整 Demo。
preserved_scope: Preserve §8.4 generic invalid-item/invalid-move rule, source/destination ordering, nil-nature exception, checkpoints/default flag behavior and all existing GN/B17 rows. No future API/class or code requirement.
synchronization: Add companion GN rows without deleting old24 rows
Global Feature Matrix/coverage/independent-review finding status by parent
regression: Unknown item still maps nil; invalid move compacts; all-invalid moves still fall back to first registry move

strongest_rebuttal: WP76 §8.4 already correctly states the general unknown-identifier outcomes, and §10.8 does not promise lossless default data. Therefore this is a proposed data/test coverage addition rather than a demonstrated incorrect clause. Parent should reject as a material defect if named shipped-data cases are not required for this assigned compatibility slice.
